main_body: A wooden cart bed (about x4-30, rows 10-20) with two wheels below, carrying three grey pots of flowers.
top_band: none. Down the middle column the order is flowers, a grey pot (rows 6-13), a dark brown line at row 13, then the brown front face. The cart's top surface is hidden behind the pots; the only trace is a thin dark rim and a small lighter patch at the right corner.
evidence: The cart bed reads as a flat brown front panel (rows 14-20) with a dark rim about 2px thick on top. No light horizontal surface is visible between the pots and the front face, unlike the reference cart bed, which has a lighter band above its front. The wheels or legs are drawn face-on. It is a front elevation with only a thin rim.

style.evidence: The flowers and leaves use several greens and reds, and the pots have 3 grey steps with per-pot highlights. The brown cart bed has only about 3-4 tones with a little grain, so it is thinner than the reference stall and well. The outlines are dark brown or dark green, not neutral black, so it does not look like a sticker. It is acceptable next to the reference, though a little simpler.
